meta.source: Radio Browser catalogue plus expanded web research across broadcaster sites, public radio directories and Tamil community radio listings
meta.note: This catalogue preserves the existing 218 records and adds distinct Tamil-language or Tamil-targeted radio feeds found through expanded web research. Exact stream URLs are deduplicated. Newly researched directory/community endpoints have a streamStatus field; legacy links are explicitly marked unverified. No network playback test was possible in this build, so directory presence or an HTTP URL must not be interpreted as confirmed live audio. Some stations without a direct URL, and one directory-reported offline stream, are documented under researchCandidatesNotAdded. The app station count is the number of records, not a guarantee that every stream is currently online.
